role: Converts CONFIRMED TrackedObjects into Observations for Layer 3 with stateful debouncing.
detail: ObservationBuilder is the final stage of Layer 2 perception that transforms confirmed tracked objects (from tracker) plus persistence results into Observation instances ready for Layer 3. Only CONFIRMED tracks produce output; TENTATIVE, LOST, and DELETED are silently filtered. Implements per-track debouncing via _EmittedRecord to suppress redundant observations when bounding box IoU exceeds debounce_iou_threshold (default 0.95) AND feature keys (dominant colors + embedding hash) are identical. Key internal functions: _features_key() hashes FeatureProfile to a tuple; _compute_iou_detection() calculates pixel-space IoU; _is_static() determines if a track should be debounced. build() processes list of TrackedObjects and returns filtered list of Observations with normalized [0.0, 1.0] bounding boxes, timestamps (from track.last_seen_at or UTC.now), SENSOR-sourced provenance, and candidate_node_id from persistence results. _build_one() constructs individual Observations with uuid IDs, session/source identifiers, confidence, embedding, dominant colors, and provenance.
gotchas: Debouncing is stateful and maintains _emitted dict across build() calls; relies on track.state filtering to skip non-CONFIRMED tracks; assumes frame_width and frame_height are positive (validates in build()); if track.last_seen_at is None, falls back to datetime.now(UTC) which may drift between cycles; persistence_result can be missing for a track (silent None handling, not an error).
